rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a Day 5 expanded 3AB blastocyst and appropriately notes strong ICM and weaker TE, but it adds speculative image-specific details (collapse, debris, chromatin definition, cavity nuances) that are not clearly supported from the provided case alone.

Integrates most key factors well: young age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth/miscarriage, endometrial thickness, BMI, smoking, and male-factor context. It connects these to prognosis, though some sperm-related discussion is speculative.

The final assessment is mostly logical, but the response contains internal inconsistency between earlier probability ranges (35-45%, 25-35% ongoing live birth) and the final estimate (40-50% implantation, 30-40% live birth), plus some unsupported speculation.

Largely aligned with standard IVF practice: recognizes 3AB as a good-quality Day 5 blastocyst, supports single embryo transfer in a 28-year-old, and gives reasonable counseling on smoking, BMI, and selective further workup. Minor deviations include overemphasis on speculative morphology and optional PGT-A discussion without stronger caution in a young patient.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support review, smoking cessation, nutritional optimization, uterine cavity reassessment, and sperm DNA fragmentation testing if failures continue. Useful and case-specific, though some recommendations remain somewhat broad.
